payload.subject: Re: Confirm visit
payload.body: hi — thanks for the note about mira's 18-month visit. let me check our calendar for tuesday june 23 at 5:30 pm and i'll get back to you to confirm.

value.rationale: I had no calendar context to check whether tue june 23 at 5:30 pm is free, so I wrote a holding reply instead of confirming the appointment.
